   Available if ᴴᵁᴹᴬᴺ is not attuned to their own reality.

   The user will return to their reality, then be extracted by AltarOS remote after the estimated time, 4 EARTH HOURS, has elapsed.
   The user will return to the home away from home.
   Repeated visits will reattune the user to their own reality.
   WARNING: Dimensional instability will make ᴴᵁᴹᴬᴺ communication impossible.

entries.developer_comments: ~ Description of book 'SHADOW URGE access codes'
identity: A series of scribbled-down alphanumeric codes, each of them at least sixteen characters long, as well as some notes about the usage of something referred to as the "SHADOW URGE process."  There's no way you'd be able to memorize all of these without having this as a reference, which is presumably why it exists.  Someone would have gotten in a lot of trouble for writing this down and then leaving it lying around, but they're probably dead by now anyway.

entries.developer_comments: ~ Description of variant 'genderfluid flag' of armor 'pride flag'
identity: A large blue, black, purple, white and pink genderfluid flag.  The genderfluid flag has a pink stripe for femininity, a blue stripe for masculinity, a purple stripe for both masculinity and femininity, a black stripe for lack of gender, and a white stripe for all genders.
